reason: Both serve businesses buying commercial property and casualty coverage, so customers overlap. AFG is a risk-bearing specialty P&C carrier. It also writes annuities, and it earns premiums and investment income. Brown & Brown is an intermediary that places policies, earns commissions and fees, and also offers benefits, personal lines and consulting. Brown & Brown is also a likely distribution channel for AFG's own policies. The offerings overlap only partly, and the business models differ. That makes it adjacent, not direct.
